Hotel Marketing & Representation Guides

How to Choose Hotel Representation in India

Choose a hotel representation partner using a written brief, comparable proposals, verified references and a pilot with measurable outcomes.

Discuss your project

Write the brief before inviting bids

State the property type, booking gaps, existing distribution and account ownership. Ask bidders to describe their first 90 days and which accounts they would qualify first.

Use a pilot to test alignment

Agree on data ownership, activity targets and what qualifies as progress. Verify working relationships with property reservations and finance before expanding scope.
